objective: Separate generated cross-material Relation candidates from the bounded set selected for expensive audit and from canonical Graph edges, without silently deleting deferred candidates or tuning ranking against audit outcomes.

lifecycle.GENERATED_CANDIDATE: A detector proposal persisted in the append-only candidate ledger; never directly consumable.
lifecycle.SELECTED_FOR_AUDIT: A bounded candidate admitted to the existing semantic, type and utility gates; still not consumable.
lifecycle.DEFERRED_BY_BUDGET: A generated candidate retained in the ledger but not audited in this run; never consumable and not equivalent to quarantine.
lifecycle.CANONICAL: A selected candidate that passes every applicable gate and is published through the existing atomic publication path.
lifecycle.QUARANTINED: A selected candidate that was audited and failed or produced an invalid audit.

forbiddenInputs: Stage B answer or gold label
orderedKeys: explicit governance priority: SUPERSEDES before ordinary candidates
rankingContract.endpointFanOut: Greedy diversity constraint over both endpoints after ranking; deferred candidates remain recoverable in the ledger.

interpretationLimits: The seven baseline canonical edges are a diagnostic set, not a human gold standard.
Passing offline replay does not prove unseen-domain recall.
A lower token count is not a pass if candidates disappear instead of entering Deferred state.
Deferred is not Quarantine: it carries no semantic failure judgment.
